about: Prefill positions and decode frames where the fp32 reference is ill-conditioned at device precision; the PCC gates skip them. Generated by make_conditioning_fixture.py (bring-up tooling, see the README).
rule: 1 - PCC(reference, device-precision proxy) >= 20.0 x the prompt's median over its prefill positions, >= 3.0 x over its first 64 decode frames
